run.title: Run {{name}}
run.description: Starts a run now. Leave ref and commit empty to use the repository's default branch head.
run.disabledHint: Enable the pipeline and a manual trigger to run it

detail.approvalWaits: Job {{job}} waits for someone with the {{ability}} ability.

meta.title: Trigger and parameters
meta.payloadValue: {{size}} ({{type}}), available to jobs as PIPELINE_WEBHOOK_PAYLOAD, never executed

failure.title: Why this run failed
failure.skipped: Skipped because an upstream job did not succeed: {{jobs}}.

artifacts.title: Artifacts
artifacts.empty: This run stored no artifacts. Add artifacts: [path] to a job to keep its output for later jobs and for download.

webhook.title: Webhook trigger for {{name}}
webhook.description: POST to a secret URL to start a run from another system. The body is passed to jobs as data and is never executed.
webhook.needsFile: Add webhook: {} under on: in the pipeline file, or runs from this URL are refused.
webhook.hmacHint: Callers sign the body with HMAC SHA-256 and send it as X-Hub-Signature-256, like GitHub.
webhook.shownOnce: Shown once. Copy it now, it cannot be read back.
webhook.rotateHint: The old URL stops working immediately.
webhook.updateFailed: The webhook could not be updated
